sloka: न च एव वानरा हन्तुम् शक्याः पादप योधिनः ।सुरा देव ऋषभेण इव रामेण हि सुरक्षिताः ।। ६-३३-१०।।
transliteration: na ca eva vānarā hantum śakyāḥ pādapa yodhinaḥ ।surā deva ṛṣabheṇa iva rāmeṇa hi surakṣitāḥ ।। 6-33-10।।

translations.english: "Vanaras are fighting with trees and are not capable of being killed. Just as the gods are protected by their Lord Indra, Vanaras are protected by Rama. It is not feasible to kill them."
